query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active') as "active!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'draining') as "draining!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'dead') as "dead!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'joining') as "joining!",
                COUNT(*) as "total!"
            FROM forge_nodes
